_doc: The list of 2026-11-14 (docs/improvements13.txt): the biomes' scenery. 926 scenery writes 'pieces' into brokenspire's WildPieces as n13_<name>#<n> and 'kinds' into WildSceneryKinds (FRDWildSceneryKind: a structure's fields plus place, uses, hazards, herd, ambush_r); 'fx' into WildSceneryFx as f13_<name>; 'channels' into WildChannelRules (the dry channels the world cuts, FRDWildWorld::MakeChannels); 'farsights' what is seen far off over a land (storm cells, a grass fire's smoke); 'mats' materials a part may lay its pieces in (mat=<name>); a kind's 'folk' its people (a townsfolk def, a title, its lines). The world places a kind in most cells of a 600 m grid of its biomes (FRDWildWorld::SceneryIn), a chunk lays it by the ruins' layout language (RD/RDWildRuin12.cpp: its parts; fx=<name> an effect at the layout's points, hours= day|night|dusk; inst=1 many as instances (patches); far=1 never culled (a landmark); L=mound|cone|ridge a rise of the land); RD/RDWildScenery13.cpp runs its uses (do=loot|forage|fish|honey|lore|heal|buff|fairy|milestone|rumour|climb|tracks), hazards (kind=collapse|sting|lurker) and herd (fauna:count;migrate;stampede;pen). A kind's front (its frame's +X) faces the road for place 'road', the meeting for 'crossroads', the water for a kind with need_water. Kit pieces (SM_N13_*) are blender_numpy/scenery13_kit.py's (926 kit).

kinds.title: Fungus glade
kinds.text: shelf fungi stepping up fallen logs, a ring of mushrooms: a forager's spot
uses: do=forage;x=6;y=0;r=3;verb=pick;what=mushrooms;things=Field Mushrooms|2|3|1,Herbs|1|1|0.5;reuse=600

kinds.name: hollow_giant
kinds.title: Hollow giant
kinds.text: an old-growth giant whose hollow trunk is big enough to shelter in
uses: do=heal;x=4;y=0;r=3;verb=shelter in;what=hollow trunk;reuse=300;text=Dry inside, and out of the wind. You sleep an hour.

kinds.name: mossy_walls
kinds.title: Mossy walls
kinds.text: mossy stone walls running through the woods from forgotten fields
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=4;r=3;verb=look along;what=walls;text=Field walls, deep in the forest. Nobody has ploughed here for a hundred years.

kinds.name: nut_cache
kinds.title: Nut cache
kinds.text: acorns and nuts heaped in the roots of an oak, squirrels and a forager arguing over them
folk: Townswoman|Forager|The squirrels were here first. The boars will come by dusk./Fill your pockets: the oaks gave twice this year.|4|2
uses: do=forage;x=2;y=0;r=3;verb=gather;what=nuts;things=Nuts and Seeds|2|4|1;reuse=600

kinds.name: charcoal_hearth
kinds.title: Charcoal hearth
kinds.text: a charcoal burner's smoking clamp, coppiced stools round it and his hut
folk: Townsman|Charcoal burner|Five days she burns, and I don't sleep for any of them./The smiths in Ashenreach buy all I make.|5|3
uses: do=trade;x=4;y=2;r=3;verb=trade with;what=charcoal burner;give=Bread|1;get=Wood Log|2;reuse=120

kinds.name: dawn_hollow
kinds.title: Misty hollow
kinds.text: a low hollow where the fog lies at dawn and dusk
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=0;r=3;verb=stand in;what=hollow;text=The cold air pools here. At dawn the fog fills it to the brim.

kinds.name: harvest_shrine
kinds.title: Harvest shrine
kinds.text: a face carved in an old oak, gourds and candles at its foot: a festival ground
uses: do=offer;x=2.6;y=0;r=2.8;verb=leave an offering at;what=carved face;give=Bread|1;name=Blessing of the Harvest;dmg=0.05;armour=0.08;secs=900;text=The carved eyes seem kinder for it.

kinds.name: watching_aspens
kinds.title: Watching aspens
kinds.text: white trunks with black, eye-like scars that seem to follow you
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=scarred trunks;text=Every scar is an eye, and every eye is on you. It is only bark. It is only bark.

kinds.name: clonal_grove
kinds.title: One grove
kinds.text: a whole hillside of aspens grown from one root: one living thing
uses: do=buff;x=0;y=0;r=3;verb=rest a hand on;what=grove;name=The Grove's Calm;dmg=0.0;armour=0.1;speed=0.05;secs=600;text=Every trunk on the hill shares one root. It is very old, and very patient.

kinds.name: carved_aspens
kinds.title: Carved trunks
kinds.text: aspens carved with names, symbols and dates by shepherds and travellers
uses: do=rumour;x=0;y=2;r=3;verb=read;what=carvings;text=Names, dates, a heart, a crude map: one carving points the way to something.

kinds.name: gold_stand
kinds.title: Golden stand
kinds.text: aspens turned bright gold against dark conifers

kinds.name: beaver_stumps
kinds.title: Beaver-felled stumps
kinds.text: pointed stumps by the stream where beavers felled the aspens; elk have browsed the rest
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=stumps;text=Gnawed to points, every one. And the low branches all bitten off at the height of an elk's mouth.

kinds.name: aspen_meadow
kinds.title: Aspen undergrowth
kinds.text: sunny, airy undergrowth of wildflowers and berries under the aspens
uses: do=forage;x=0;y=0;r=3;verb=pick;what=berries;things=Wild Berries|2|4|1;reuse=600

kinds.name: aspen_edge
kinds.title: Grove's edge
kinds.text: where the aspens meet the pines: a cold camp, and someone watching from the trees

kinds.name: windthrow
kinds.title: Windthrow
kinds.text: a storm's swath of fallen trees, root plates torn up: a barrier, a bridge, a hiding place
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=-8;r=3;verb=look at;what=fallen trees;text=One storm laid them all the same way. You could cross the gully on that trunk.

kinds.name: hillfort
kinds.title: Hillfort
kinds.text: the earthen rings and ditches of an old fort on the summit
uses: do=lore;x=-4;y=3;r=3;verb=look over;what=ramparts;text=Two rings of bank and ditch, the gate on the side away from the wind. Older than any town.

kinds.name: chalk_figure
kinds.title: Chalk horse
kinds.text: a great horse cut into the hillside, white chalk showing through the turf: seen for miles
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=-24;r=3;verb=look at;what=chalk horse;text=Somebody scours it every seven years, or the turf would have it back.

kinds.name: terraced_fields
kinds.title: Terraced fields
kinds.text: terraced fields stepping down the slope, held by drystone walls along the contours
uses: do=forage;x=0;y=3;r=3;verb=gather;what=herbs in the terraces;things=Herbs|1|2|1;reuse=600

kinds.name: dew_pond
kinds.title: Dew pond
kinds.text: a round pond on the hilltop, lined with clay, that never seems to dry
uses: do=heal;x=7.5;y=0;r=3;verb=drink at;what=dew pond;reuse=300;text=Rain, mist and dew, held in the clay. It is cold and clean.

kinds.name: folly_tower
kinds.title: Folly tower
kinds.text: a lord's folly: a tower on the crest built for the view and nothing else
uses: do=climb;edge=1;r=3.5;verb=climb;what=folly;tz=10;reveal=2500;reuse=5;text=From the top of the folly the hills roll away on every side.

kinds.name: beacon_hill
kinds.title: Beacon hill
kinds.text: a beacon on the crest, ready to pass a warning from hill to hill; it burns at night
uses: do=lore;x=3;y=-3;r=3;verb=look at;what=beacon;text=Lit, it would be seen from the next hill, and that one's from the next. It is kept dry and ready.

kinds.name: quarry
kinds.title: Old quarry
kinds.text: a quarry cut into the hillside, its tools left lying, a cave behind its face

kinds.name: hillside_vines
kinds.title: Hillside vines
kinds.text: old vines in rows on a sunny slope, and a few sheep among them
uses: do=forage;x=0;y=6;r=3;verb=pick;what=grapes;things=Grapes|2|4|1;reuse=600

kinds.name: combe
kinds.title: Hidden combe
kinds.text: a hidden valley tucked between the hills, a hermit's hut in it
folk: Townsman|Hermit|You found the combe. Most walk past it on the ridge and never know./Take an apple. Tell no one./The hills keep their secrets in their folds.|5|-1
uses: do=forage;x=-6;y=6;r=3;verb=pick;what=apples;things=Wild Apples|2|3|1;reuse=600

kinds.name: peat_hags
kinds.title: Peat hags
kinds.text: black peat hags and sinking ground; lights drift over them at night
uses: do=lore;x=-12;y=4;r=3;verb=look at;what=peat hags;text=The lights drift over the bog at night. Follow them and the moor keeps you.

kinds.name: tor
kinds.title: Tor
kinds.text: a wind-sculpted granite stack on the hilltop: a lookout, and a lair
uses: do=climb;edge=1;r=3.5;verb=climb;what=tor;tz=5;reveal=2000;reuse=5;text=The granite is warm in the sun. The moor rolls away in every direction.

kinds.name: heather_gorse
kinds.title: Heather and gorse
kinds.text: heather blooming purple and gorse gold, dry enough to burn
uses: do=forage;x=0;y=0;r=3;verb=gather;what=heather;things=Herbs|1|2|1;reuse=600;text=Heather tips, for a tea. Gorse flowers smell of coconut in the sun.

kinds.name: stone_row
kinds.title: Stone row
kinds.text: a row of standing stones, and the rings of old hut circles beside it
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=-4;r=3;verb=walk along;what=stone row;text=It runs straight at the hill on the skyline. Whoever raised it lived in those rings of stone.

kinds.name: peat_cutting
kinds.title: Peat cutting
kinds.text: peat banks cut into the moor, turves stacked to dry
uses: do=forage;x=0;y=8;r=3;verb=take;what=dried turves;things=Peat Turf|2|4|1;reuse=600;text=Dry enough to burn. The cutter won't miss a few.

kinds.name: moor_mist
kinds.title: Mist on the moor
kinds.text: a rolling mist that hides the landmarks: easy to get lost in
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=0;r=3;verb=stand in;what=mist;text=Every way looks the same. The stone row was to the north. Or was it?

kinds.name: bothy
kinds.title: Shepherd's bothy
kinds.text: a lonely bothy, its door unlocked for whoever needs it, a ruined shieling beyond
uses: do=heal;x=5;y=0;r=3;verb=rest in;what=bothy;reuse=300;text=A dry floor, a fireplace, a note asking you to leave kindling for the next one.

kinds.name: grouse_butts
kinds.title: Grouse butts
kinds.text: a line of shooting butts across the moor, a hunting lodge and its gamekeeper
folk: Townsman|Gamekeeper|Keep to the path: the birds are sitting./The lord comes up for the season. Until then the moor is mine./You'll not have seen a fox? I've lost three hens to one.|-8|6
uses: do=trade;x=-8;y=4;r=3;verb=trade with;what=gamekeeper;give=Coarse Hide|1;get=Bread|2;reuse=120

kinds.name: moor_ford
kinds.title: Peat-water ford
kinds.text: stepping stones over a stream running brown with peat
uses: do=fish;x=1;y=-4;r=3;verb=fish;what=brown water;things=Fish|1|2|0.8;reuse=240;text=Trout, dark as the water.

kinds.name: switchback
kinds.title: Switchback trail
kinds.text: a trail cut into the slope in switchbacks, a mule train on it; stones come down from above
uses: do=lore;x=-12;y=6;r=3;verb=look up at;what=slope;text=Every switchback has its fallen stones. Nobody stops on this trail.

kinds.name: alpine_pasture
kinds.title: Alpine pasture
kinds.text: a summer pasture high in the mountains: cows, a cheese hut, a herder
folk: Townswoman|Herder|We bring them up when the snow goes and down before it comes./The cheese wants the whole summer. Taste last year's./You hear the bells before you see the cows.|5|2
uses: do=trade;x=4;y=1;r=3;verb=trade with;what=herder;give=Bread|1;get=Cheese|2;reuse=120

kinds.name: mountain_pass
kinds.title: Mountain pass
kinds.text: the pass between the peaks, held by a gate and its towers; a toll is asked
folk: Townsman|Toll keeper|The pass is the duke's, and the duke likes bread./Pay, and the guards on the far side know your face./Snow closes it by the first frost. Hurry, if you mean to cross.|5|-3
uses: do=offer;x=5;y=-1;r=3;verb=pay the toll at;what=gate;give=Bread|1;name=Safe Conduct;dmg=0.0;armour=0.1;speed=0.05;secs=900;text=The keeper stamps a tally and waves you through.

kinds.name: scree_slope
kinds.title: Scree slope
kinds.text: a slope of loose broken stone that slides underfoot
uses: do=lore;x=-4;y=15;r=3;verb=look at;what=scree;text=Every stone is waiting to go. So are you, if you cross it.

kinds.name: hanging_waterfall
kinds.title: Hanging waterfall
kinds.text: a waterfall dropping off a hanging valley's lip
uses: do=fish;x=2;y=-4;r=3;verb=fish;what=pool below the fall;things=Fish|1|2|0.85;reuse=240;text=The cold pool under the fall is full of trout.

kinds.name: mine_adit
kinds.title: Mine adit
kinds.text: a mine's adit bored into the rock: ore carts, rails, tailings

kinds.name: cliff_shrine
kinds.title: Cliff shrine
kinds.text: a shrine on a rock stack, reachable only by ladders
uses: do=climb;edge=1;r=4;verb=climb;what=ladders;tz=9;reveal=2500;reuse=5;text=Up the ladders to the shrine. The monks left long ago, the view did not.

kinds.name: rope_bridge
kinds.title: Rope bridge
kinds.text: a rope bridge slung across a gorge between two rock stacks
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=-8;r=3;verb=look at;what=bridge;text=Rope and planks and nothing under them. Someone mends it; the new planks are pale.

kinds.name: tarn
kinds.title: Tarn
kinds.text: a small dark lake cupped in a rock basin
uses: do=fish;x=1;y=0;r=3;verb=fish;what=dark water;things=Fish|1|2|0.8;reuse=240;text=The water is black and very cold.

kinds.name: goat_ledges
kinds.title: Goat ledges
kinds.text: mountain goats on impossible ledges, eagles over them
uses: do=lore;x=4;y=6;r=3;verb=watch;what=goats;text=They stand where nothing should. One looks down at you, chewing.

kinds.name: arete
kinds.title: Knife-edge ridge
kinds.text: a narrow ridge with sheer drops on both sides; its snow overhangs
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=-9;r=3;verb=look along;what=ridge;text=A path a boot wide along its crest. The snow on its edge overhangs nothing.

kinds.name: summit_cairn
kinds.title: Summit cairn
kinds.text: a summit cairn with prayer flags, and the bones of those who never came down
uses: do=offer;x=3;y=0;r=3;verb=leave a stone at;what=cairn;give=Bread|1;name=Blessing of the Summit;dmg=0.08;armour=0.08;secs=600;text=You add a stone to the cairn, as every climber does.

kinds.name: cornice_edge
kinds.title: Cornice
kinds.text: snow overhanging a drop, smooth and treacherous
uses: do=lore;x=-10;y=4;r=3;verb=look at;what=snow;text=It looks solid. It is not. The drop under it is a long one.

kinds.name: avalanche_chute
kinds.title: Avalanche chute
kinds.text: a chute cleared by past slides, broken trunks at its foot; more snow above
uses: do=lore;x=-14;y=6;r=3;verb=look up;what=chute;text=Nothing grows in the chute. Everything that did lies broken at its foot.

kinds.name: couloir
kinds.title: Couloir
kinds.text: a steep gully between rock walls: a way up, and a way stones come down
uses: do=lore;x=-10;y=0;r=3;verb=look up;what=gully;text=The quickest way up. The stones know it too.

kinds.name: rime_ledge
kinds.title: Rime ledge
kinds.text: wind-carved snow, rime-coated rock and ice-glazed ledges
uses: do=lore;x=-10;y=4;r=3;verb=look at;what=rime;text=The wind has built feathers of ice on every stone, all pointing the same way.

kinds.name: climbers_camp
kinds.title: Abandoned climbers' camp
kinds.text: frozen tents, ropes and a journal left on the mountain
uses: do=lore;x=-4;y=4;r=3;verb=read;what=journal;text=Day nine. The weather will not break. We go for the summit tomorrow either way.

kinds.name: cloud_sea
kinds.title: Above the clouds
kinds.text: a high rock above a sea of cloud, other peaks rising like islands
uses: do=climb;edge=1;r=3.5;verb=climb;what=rock;tz=3;reveal=3000;reuse=5;text=Cloud below you to every horizon, and the peaks standing out of it like islands.

kinds.name: dragon_aerie
kinds.title: Aerie
kinds.text: a nest of whole trees on a high ledge, bones round it: something enormous nests here
hazards: kind=wakes;x=0;y=0;r=7;who=Daemon;named=The Aerie's Drake;n=1;msg=A shadow falls over the nest: its keeper is home

kinds.name: crevasse_field
kinds.title: Crevasse field
kinds.text: ice split by crevasses, some open, some hidden under snow bridges
uses: do=lore;x=-12;y=-6;r=3;verb=look at;what=crevasses;text=The open ones are easy. It is the smooth snow between them you should fear.

kinds.name: serac_field
kinds.title: Seracs
kinds.text: towers of glacier ice that could topple at any time
uses: do=lore;x=-14;y=4;r=3;verb=look up at;what=seracs;text=They lean a little further every day. One of them goes today.

kinds.name: ice_cave
kinds.title: Ice cave
kinds.text: an ice cave's mouth, blue light within, meltwater running out of it
uses: do=lore;x=4;y=0;r=3;verb=look into;what=ice cave;text=Blue light, the sound of running water, and the cold breathing out of it.

kinds.name: moulin
kinds.title: Moulin
kinds.text: a vertical shaft where the meltwater drains into the glacier
uses: do=lore;x=-5;y=0;r=3;verb=look down;what=shaft;text=The meltwater pours down into the dark, a long way down, still falling.

kinds.name: moraine
kinds.title: Moraine
kinds.text: a ridge of rock and gravel pushed up by the ice
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=-10;r=3;verb=look at;what=moraine;text=The ice pushed all this here, and went back the way it came.

kinds.name: meltwater_lake
kinds.title: Meltwater lake
kinds.text: a lake of milky meltwater at the ice's foot
uses: do=lore;x=-11;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=meltwater;text=Milky with stone ground fine by the ice. Little lives in it, and it is cold enough to stop a heart.

kinds.name: frozen_thing
kinds.title: Frozen in the ice
kinds.text: something enormous frozen in a block of clear ice
uses: do=lore;x=-4;y=0;r=3;verb=look into;what=ice;text=Ribs as long as you are tall, held in the ice. Whatever it was, it is not a bear.

kinds.name: nunatak
kinds.title: Nunatak
kinds.text: a rocky peak poking through the ice sheet like an island
uses: do=climb;edge=1;r=3.5;verb=climb;what=rock;tz=4;reveal=2500;reuse=5;text=Rock under your hands for the first time in days. The ice runs away on every side.

kinds.name: ice_ruins
kinds.title: Ruins in the ice
kinds.text: the walls of something old, coming out of the ice as the glacier goes back
uses: do=lore;x=-9;y=4;r=3;verb=look at;what=walls;text=Cut stone, older than the ice that buried it. More of it shows every summer.

kinds.name: banded_wall
kinds.title: Banded cliff
kinds.text: a canyon wall in coloured bands, layer on layer, bones of something old in one of them
uses: do=lore;x=2;y=5;r=3;verb=look at;what=strata;text=Red, cream, red, brown: each band an age of the world. In the third from the floor, bones as long as your arm.

kinds.name: slot_canyon
kinds.title: Slot canyon
kinds.text: a slot canyon a few strides wide, light falling into it in shafts; the floor is no place to be in a storm
uses: do=lore;x=-14;y=0;r=3;verb=look up;what=walls;text=The sky is a crooked ribbon far above. Driftwood is jammed in the walls higher than your head.

kinds.name: canyon_creek
kinds.title: Canyon creek
kinds.text: a creek running down the canyon floor, cottonwoods along it, a sandbar
uses: do=fish;x=-10;y=0;r=3;verb=fish;what=creek;things=Fish|1|2|0.8;reuse=240;text=Small quick fish in the shade of the cottonwoods.

kinds.name: cliff_dwelling
kinds.title: Cliff dwellings
kinds.text: rooms of mud brick tucked into an alcove under the canyon wall, empty for an age
uses: do=loot;x=2;y=0;r=3;verb=search;what=rooms;things=Bread|1|1|0.5,Small Healing Potion|1|1|0.5,Straw Rope|1|2|0.7;reuse=900;text=Corn cobs in a bin, a cracked pot, a child's handprint in the plaster.

kinds.name: petroglyph_panel
kinds.title: Petroglyph panel
kinds.text: handprints, spirals and figures pecked into the wall; nobody can say what they mean
uses: do=lore;x=1;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=carvings;text=Handprints, spirals, a horned figure with too many fingers. Somebody wanted this remembered.

kinds.name: natural_arch
kinds.title: Natural arch
kinds.text: a span of banded stone carved by wind and water, the sky through it
uses: do=lore;x=-10;y=0;r=3;verb=look up at;what=arch;text=Wind and water and a long, long time. One day it falls; not today, you hope.

kinds.name: hanging_garden
kinds.title: Hanging garden
kinds.text: ferns and flowers growing where a seep leaks out of the rock
uses: do=forage;x=2;y=4;r=3;verb=gather from;what=seep;things=Wild Berries|1|2|0.8;reuse=300;text=Water beads on the rock and drips; maidenhair and monkeyflowers live on it.

kinds.name: echo_point
kinds.title: Echo point
kinds.text: a ledge over the canyon where a voice comes back, and sometimes something else does
uses: do=echo;x=0;y=0;r=3;verb=call out over;what=canyon;text=You shout into the canyon.;echo=Your voice comes back from the far wall, and then a second voice, a beat late, that is not yours.

kinds.name: rockfall_scar
kinds.title: Rockfall
kinds.text: a fresh scar on the wall, toppled boulders under it; more is waiting to come down
uses: do=lore;x=-8;y=6;r=3;verb=look at;what=scar;text=The stone under the scar is pale, unweathered: this came down this year.

kinds.name: toehold_trail
kinds.title: Toe-hold trail
kinds.text: steps cut into the rock up a wall, an old rope ladder for the worst of it
uses: do=climb;edge=1;r=4;verb=climb;what=steps;tx=8;tz=9;reveal=2500;reuse=5;text=Toe-holds worn smooth by a thousand years of feet, then the rope. The rim, and the whole canyon under you.

kinds.name: box_canyon
kinds.title: Box canyon
kinds.text: a dead end of sheer walls: one way in, the same way out
uses: do=lore;x=-14;y=0;r=3;verb=look into;what=dead end;text=Walls on three sides and old bones on the floor. A good place to be trapped. Somebody knew it.

kinds.name: junction_cairn
kinds.title: Canyon junction
kinds.text: where side canyons split: a cairn, a carving and a warning scratched under it
uses: do=lore;x=-6;y=5;r=3;verb=read;what=warning;text=Scratched under the carving: LEFT TO WATER. RIGHT TO DEATH. And under that, in another hand: both wrong.

kinds.name: hidden_side_canyon
kinds.title: Hidden side canyon
kinds.text: a squeeze between two walls a body wide, and something kept beyond it
uses: do=lore;x=-12;y=6;r=3;verb=look at;what=squeeze;text=Sideways, breath out, stone on both shoulders. Footprints go in. None come out.

kinds.name: pour_off
kinds.title: Pour-off
kinds.text: a dry waterfall: a smooth lip of rock the flood pours over, too high to walk
uses: do=climb;edge=1;r=4;verb=climb;what=pour-off;tx=8;tz=6;reveal=1500;reuse=5;text=Polished stone, a scoop worn by falling water, handholds where it broke. Up and over.

kinds.name: tinaja
kinds.title: Tinaja
kinds.text: rock basins full of rain water: the only drink for miles
uses: do=heal;x=-3;y=-3;r=3;verb=drink from;what=tinaja;reuse=300;text=Rain water, warm, full of wriggling things. You drink it all the same.

kinds.name: outlaw_hideout
kinds.title: Outlaw hideout
kinds.text: a camp tucked against the wall: a fire, bedrolls and a lookout on the rim
uses: do=lore;x=-6;y=6;r=3;verb=look at;what=camp;text=Still warm ashes. Whoever they are, they watch the canyon floor from up there.

kinds.name: gold_wash
kinds.title: Panning wash
kinds.text: an old placer working on a wash: a sluice box, tailings, a mine's frame in the bank
uses: do=forage;x=-2;y=-5;r=3;verb=pan;what=gravel;things=Copper Ingot|1|1|0.6,Iron Ingot|1|1|0.4;reuse=600;text=Black sand, a few flakes of colour. Not a fortune; a day's wage, maybe.

kinds.name: flood_debris
kinds.title: Flood debris
kinds.text: logs and branches jammed high in the walls: how high the water gets
uses: do=lore;x=-12;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=debris;text=A whole tree, wedged across the canyon twice your height up. The water put it there.

kinds.name: hoodoo_forest
kinds.title: Hoodoos
kinds.text: a stone forest of hoodoos and fins, each with its cap balanced on top
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=0;r=3;verb=look up at;what=hoodoos;text=Spires of soft stone under hard caps. Where a cap has fallen the spire is already half gone.

kinds.name: dry_wash
kinds.title: Dry wash
kinds.text: a dry wash under a darkening sky; thunder far up the canyons
uses: do=lore;x=-13;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=wash;text=Mud cracked in plates, a tide line on the walls. When it rains up there, it floods down here.

kinds.name: banded_butte
kinds.title: Banded butte
kinds.text: a lone butte of banded stone, sheer-sided, a talus apron round its foot
uses: do=lore;x=-21;y=4;r=3;verb=look up at;what=butte;text=Layer on layer on layer, and on top a flat world nobody has walked.

kinds.name: mesa_pueblo
kinds.title: Mesa-top pueblo
kinds.text: a pueblo of mud-brick rooms on the mesa's top, reached by one carved stair
folk: Townswoman|Pueblo elder|One stair, cut by our grandmothers' grandmothers. Nobody climbs it we do not see./Up here the floods cannot reach us, nor the bandits./Bring us bread from the lowlands and you are welcome.|-6|-4
uses: do=trade;x=-8;y=-2;r=3;verb=trade with;what=elder;give=Bread|2;get=Cheese|1;reuse=120

kinds.name: spire
kinds.title: Spire
kinds.text: a needle of stone standing alone, its top a nest of something
uses: do=lore;x=-11;y=0;r=3;verb=look up at;what=spire;text=A finger of stone, the softer layers wearing out from under the hard. Birds circle its top.

kinds.name: talus_apron
kinds.title: Talus apron
kinds.text: a steep apron of rubble round a mesa's foot; it shifts underfoot
uses: do=lore;x=-8;y=5;r=3;verb=look at;what=talus;text=All of this was the mesa once. A little more of it comes down with every frost.

kinds.name: overlook
kinds.title: Overlook
kinds.text: the edge of the mesa: the desert below to the horizon
uses: do=climb;edge=1;r=3.5;verb=climb;what=rock;tx=-4;tz=3;reveal=4000;reuse=5;text=The land drops away, red and gold and blue with distance, farther than a day's ride.

kinds.name: sky_shrine
kinds.title: Sky shrine
kinds.text: a slab with a spiral pecked into it, two stones leaning before it: at sunrise a blade of light crosses the spiral
uses: do=buff;x=-4;y=0;r=3;verb=watch;what=spiral;hours=sunrise;early=The spiral lies in shadow. The sun's blade crosses it only at sunrise.;name=The Sun's Blade;dmg=0.12;armour=0.05;secs=900;reuse=60;text=The first sun slides between the stones and a blade of light splits the spiral at its heart.

kinds.name: caprock_pools
kinds.title: Caprock pools
kinds.text: rain pools on the wind-scoured caprock, lizards sunning round them
uses: do=heal;x=-3;y=3;r=3;verb=drink from;what=pool;reuse=300;text=Yesterday's rain, warm from the stone. Lizards flick away from your shadow.

kinds.name: condor_ledge
kinds.title: Condor ledge
kinds.text: a great nest on a ledge under the rim, condors riding the air below
uses: do=forage;x=2;y=4;r=3;verb=reach into;what=nest;things=Bird's Eggs|1|2|0.8;reuse=600;text=Eggs the size of your fist. The parent's shadow passes over you, once, twice.

kinds.name: lone_juniper
kinds.title: Lone juniper
kinds.text: a single twisted juniper clinging to the rim
uses: do=lore;x=3;y=4;r=3;verb=look at;what=juniper;text=Half its trunk is dead silver wood. The other half still holds on, roots in a crack, older than any town.

kinds.name: storm_below
kinds.title: Storm below
kinds.text: the mesa's edge in a storm's season: weather passing below you, lightning under the rim
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=4;r=3;verb=look down at;what=weather;text=Rain falls in grey veils on the desert below; lightning stitches the plain, and you stand dry above it all.

kinds.name: lava_flow
kinds.title: Lava flow
kinds.text: a river of lava glowing under its cooling crust, the crust black and cracked either side
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=-12;r=3;verb=look at;what=flow;text=The crust is black and it creaks. Under it, the orange shows through every crack.

kinds.name: lava_tube
kinds.title: Lava tube
kinds.text: the mouth of a lava tube: a tunnel the lava left when it drained away, going down into the dark
uses: do=lore;x=6;y=-6;r=3;verb=look into;what=tube;text=Warm air breathes out of it. The walls are glazed where the lava ran, and something has made a home in the dark.

kinds.name: cinder_cone
kinds.title: Cinder cone
kinds.text: a small black hill of loose scoria round a crater
uses: do=lore;x=-17;y=4;r=3;verb=look at;what=cone;text=Cinders the size of fists, loose as gravel. Every step up slides half a step down.

kinds.name: ash_village
kinds.title: Ash-buried village
kinds.text: a village buried in ash: only roofs and the church's spire stand out of it
uses: do=loot;x=-4;y=-3;r=3;verb=dig at;what=buried door;things=Bread|1|1|0.4,Iron Ingot|1|2|0.7,Small Healing Potion|1|1|0.5;reuse=900;text=You scrape the ash from a door and reach inside a buried kitchen.

kinds.name: volcanic_bombs
kinds.title: Volcanic bombs
kinds.text: blobs of rock the crater threw out, cooled in flight, scattered across the slope
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=bombs;text=Each one landed still soft and split open as it cooled. The crater is two miles off.

kinds.name: fumarole_field
kinds.title: Fumaroles
kinds.text: vents hissing sulfur steam, yellow crystal crusts round them
uses: do=forage;x=-4;y=-4;r=3;verb=scrape;what=sulfur;things=Sulfur|1|3|0.9;reuse=300;text=Yellow crystals flake off into your hand. The smell of rotten eggs follows you for an hour.

kinds.name: obsidian_field
kinds.title: Obsidian field
kinds.text: a field of black volcanic glass, sharp as knives
hazards: kind=pit;x=4;y=0;r=2.5;msg=The glass's edges cut through your boots
uses: do=forage;x=-4;y=-5;r=3;verb=gather;what=obsidian;things=Obsidian|1|2|0.9;reuse=300;text=Black glass, smooth as water on one face and sharper than any blade on the other.

kinds.name: crater_rim
kinds.title: Volcano's shoulder
kinds.text: high on the volcano's shoulder: the crater smokes above, the land falls away below
uses: do=climb;edge=1;r=3.5;verb=climb;what=rock;tx=-4;tz=2.5;reveal=4000;reuse=5;text=Smoke pours off the crater above you and the whole country lies below.

kinds.name: eruption_signs
kinds.title: Eruption signs
kinds.text: the ground trembles, ash falls from a clear sky, dead birds lie in the grey
uses: do=lore;x=-14;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=dead birds;text=Small birds, dozens of them, dead where they fell. The air at the ground is wrong. Something is coming.

kinds.name: fire_temple
kinds.title: Fire temple
kinds.text: a temple built to tap the mountain's heat: a forge's brazier, a keeper of the flame
folk: Townsman|Keeper of the flame|The mountain's fire is ours to borrow, never to keep./Leave bread, and its heat goes with you a while./When it shakes, we pray. When it smokes, we run.|-1|-5
uses: do=offer;x=-3;y=1;r=3;verb=leave an offering at;what=brazier;give=Bread|1;name=The Mountain's Heat;dmg=0.12;armour=0.06;secs=600;text=The keeper takes the bread and casts it in the fire, and nods to you.

kinds.name: lava_lake
kinds.title: Lava lake
kinds.text: a lake of lava in a pit, its black skin splitting and turning over
uses: do=lore;x=-17;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=lava;text=The heat comes off it like a wall. Its skin cracks, glows, and folds under.

kinds.name: moss_lava
kinds.title: Moss-covered lava
kinds.text: soft green moss blanketing jagged lava; it hides the holes
hazards: kind=pit;x=3;y=2;r=2.5;msg=The moss gives way over a hole in the lava and your leg goes in to the knee
uses: do=lore;x=-16;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=moss;text=A hundred years of moss over the lava. Soft as a mattress, and under it, holes you could lose a leg in.

kinds.name: black_sand
kinds.title: Black sand
kinds.text: a plain of black volcanic sand, blocks of glacier ice stranded on it
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=ice;text=White ice on black sand, melting in the sun. The glacier calved it a mile upstream.

kinds.name: basalt_columns
kinds.title: Basalt columns
kinds.text: hexagonal pillars of basalt, stepped like the stairs of giants
uses: do=climb;edge=1;r=4;verb=climb;what=columns;tz=6;reveal=2000;reuse=5;text=Six-sided steps, each a giant's stair, up to the top of the columns.

kinds.name: glacier_flood
kinds.title: Meltwater flood
kinds.text: a fissure that floods when the volcano under the ice melts it from below
uses: do=lore;x=-13;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=ice;text=Blocks of ice in a dry rift. When the fire under the glacier wakes, the meltwater comes down here all at once.

kinds.name: rift_fissure
kinds.title: Rift
kinds.text: a fissure where the land is pulling apart; you can stand inside it
uses: do=lore;x=-10;y=0;r=3;verb=look up at;what=walls;text=One wall is this land, the other wall another. They are a finger's width further apart each year.

kinds.name: pseudocraters
kinds.title: Pseudocraters
kinds.text: small mossy craters where lava ran over wet ground and the steam burst through
uses: do=lore;x=4;y=-9;r=3;verb=look at;what=craters;text=No mountain made these: the lava ran over a marsh, and the marsh boiled up through it.

kinds.name: sod_farm
kinds.title: Turf farm
kinds.text: a turf-roofed farmhouse, a stone sheep pen, a farmer and her sheep
folk: Townswoman|Farmer|The turf keeps the cold out and the roof green./Lava field to the north. Do not walk it in fog./Bread for wool, if you have it.|0|-5
uses: do=trade;x=-2;y=-6;r=3;verb=trade with;what=farmer;give=Bread|1;get=Cheese|1;reuse=120

kinds.name: hot_river
kinds.title: Hot river
kinds.text: a river steaming through the snow, warm enough to bathe in
uses: do=heal;x=1;y=-3;r=3;verb=bathe in;what=hot river;reuse=300;text=Warm water in cold air. The ache goes out of you.

kinds.name: troll_rocks
kinds.title: Troll rocks
kinds.text: rock pillars the stories say are giants caught by the dawn and turned to stone
uses: do=lore;x=-14;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=rocks;text=Squint, and there are the faces: the brow, the nose, the open mouth. Caught at sunrise, the stories say.

kinds.name: geyser
kinds.title: Geyser
kinds.text: a geyser's white cone; it erupts on a schedule you can set a clock by
uses: do=geyser;x=-11;y=0;r=3;verb=watch;what=geyser;text=Steam drifts off the cone and the pool in it rises and falls.

kinds.name: terraced_pools
kinds.title: Terraced pools
kinds.text: hot pools on mineral terraces in white, orange and teal steps
uses: do=heal;x=-11;y=0;r=3;verb=bathe in;what=pools;reuse=300;text=You lower yourself into the warm teal water, and the mineral steps hold you like a chair.

kinds.name: mud_pots
kinds.title: Mud pots
kinds.text: pools of grey mud boiling and plopping
uses: do=lore;x=-8;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=mud;text=Grey mud heaves up in a bubble, holds, and bursts with a wet plop. It is boiling.

kinds.name: bacterial_mats
kinds.title: Bacterial mats
kinds.text: runoff coloured in bright rainbow bands by what lives in the hot water
uses: do=lore;x=-13;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=colours;text=Orange, yellow, green, teal: each ring as hot as the life in it can stand.

kinds.name: thin_crust
kinds.title: Thin crust
kinds.text: pale ground that looks solid; boiling water lies under it
uses: do=lore;x=-9;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=crust;text=It rings hollow under a thrown stone. Steam seeps from a crack. Walk round.

kinds.name: steam_field
kinds.title: Steam field
kinds.text: a field of vents where the steam drops visibility to nothing
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=steam;text=White on every side. You hear the vents hiss and cannot tell how near.

kinds.name: crater_lake
kinds.title: Crater lake
kinds.text: a lake filling the caldera, turquoise and strange
uses: do=lore;x=-24;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=lake;text=The colour of a jewel, and nothing lives in it. The water is sour; the birds will not land.

kinds.name: resurgent_dome
kinds.title: Resurgent dome
kinds.text: the caldera's floor rising in a dome, cracked in rings: the next eruption on its way
uses: do=lore;x=-34;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=dome;text=The ground here is higher than it was last year. The cracks round it are new.

kinds.name: spa_village
kinds.title: Spa village
kinds.text: a bathhouse and a few houses round a hot spring, a healer keeping it
folk: Townswoman|Bath keeper|The water cures what the doctors cannot./Bread for a bath, and the bath is yours./Do not drink it. Bathe in it.|-4|-6
uses: do=heal;x=-6;y=0;r=3;verb=bathe in;what=spring;reuse=300;text=Hot mineral water to the chin. Your wounds close as you soak.

kinds.name: petrified_forest
kinds.title: Dead forest
kinds.text: trees killed by heat and gas, standing bare and white
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=trees;text=Bleached white, bark gone, still standing. Nothing rotted them; nothing here lives to.

kinds.name: gas_hollow
kinds.title: Gas hollow
kinds.text: a still hollow where gas collects; animals lie dead in it
uses: do=lore;x=-12;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=hollow;text=A fox, a deer, a hawk, all lying where they fell, untouched. No scavenger comes down here either.

kinds.name: polygon_ground
kinds.title: Polygon ground
kinds.text: frost-cracked ground in a honeycomb of polygons, plain from above
uses: do=lore;x=-16;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=cracks;text=Every winter the ground cracks the same way, and every summer ice fills the cracks. Six sides, over and over, to the horizon.

kinds.name: thaw_lake
kinds.title: Thaw lake
kinds.text: a summer thaw lake, one of thousands, and the mosquitoes it breeds
hazards: kind=sting;x=-2;y=-9;r=4;msg=Mosquitoes in a whining cloud: they find every bare inch of you
uses: do=fish;x=2;y=4;r=3;verb=fish;what=thaw lake;things=Fish|1|2|0.7;reuse=240;text=Shallow and warm for a few weeks a year. The fish know it.

kinds.name: caribou_migration
kinds.title: Caribou migration
kinds.text: caribou on their long walk, a trampled trail behind them, wolves shadowing the herd
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=-12;r=3;verb=look at;what=trail;text=A trail trampled bare by ten thousand hooves, the same trail every year. The wolves walk beside it.

kinds.name: inuksuk
kinds.title: Inuksuk
kinds.text: a figure of stacked stones pointing the way
uses: do=milestone;x=-4;y=3;r=3;verb=read the way from;what=stones;text=Its arms point the way travellers went before you.

kinds.name: mammoth_bones
kinds.title: Mammoth bones
kinds.text: a mammoth's tusks and skull coming out of the thawing permafrost
uses: do=lore;x=6;y=-6;r=3;verb=look at;what=tusks;text=Ivory longer than you are tall, coming up out of the mud as the ground thaws. Nobody alive has seen the beast that wore it.

kinds.name: cotton_grass
kinds.title: Cotton grass
kinds.text: a tundra meadow of cotton grass, lichen and dwarf willow: a forest at ankle height
uses: do=forage;x=0;y=0;r=3;verb=gather from;what=low bushes;things=Wild Berries|1|2|0.8;reuse=300;text=Cloudberries among the dwarf willow, the whole forest knee-high.

kinds.name: wolf_den
kinds.title: Wolf den
kinds.text: a den dug into a rise, bones round its mouth
uses: do=tracks;x=-9;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=tracks;text=Paw prints the size of your hand, coming and going.

kinds.name: summer_bloom
kinds.title: Summer bloom
kinds.text: a short burst of wildflowers across the whole plain
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=flowers;text=Three weeks of summer, and every one of them in flower at once.

kinds.name: reindeer_camp
kinds.title: Reindeer herders' camp
kinds.text: a reindeer herders' camp: tents, a sledge, fish drying, a pile of antlers
folk: Townsman|Herder|We follow the herd; the herd follows the grass./Dried fish for bread, if you like./Wolves this year. They walk where the herd walks.|-2|-3
uses: do=trade;x=-3;y=1;r=3;verb=trade with;what=herder;give=Bread|1;get=Fish|2;reuse=120

kinds.name: pressure_ridge
kinds.title: Pressure ridge
kinds.text: a jagged wall of ice pushed up where the floes ground together
hazards: kind=drift;x=0;y=7;r=5;msg=Broken ice and drifted snow: every step is a climb
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=-9;r=3;verb=look at;what=ridge;text=Blocks of sea ice the size of carts, heaved up and frozen where they fell.

kinds.name: open_lead
kinds.title: Open lead
kinds.text: a crack of black water opened between the floes
hazards: kind=thin_ice;x=0;y=3.5;r=2;msg=The ice at the lead's edge gives under you: black water to your waist
uses: do=lore;x=-8;y=-8;r=3;verb=look at;what=lead;text=Black water, smoking with cold. It was not there yesterday; tomorrow it will be somewhere else.

kinds.name: iceberg_cave
kinds.title: Iceberg cave
kinds.text: an iceberg locked in the sea ice, hollowed into a cave
uses: do=lore;x=6;y=-6;r=3;verb=look into;what=cave;text=Blue light inside the berg, and the cold breathing out of it.

kinds.name: sastrugi
kinds.title: Sastrugi
kinds.text: wind-carved ridges of hard snow that make walking hard
uses: do=lore;x=-12;y=-10;r=3;verb=look at;what=snow;text=The wind has carved the snow into waves frozen hard as wood, all running one way.

kinds.name: seal_holes
kinds.title: Seal holes
kinds.text: seals' breathing holes in the sea ice
uses: do=lore;x=-12;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=holes;text=Little domes of ice, each over a hole. A hunter waits by one for a day; a bear waits longer.

kinds.name: bear_tracks
kinds.title: Bear tracks
kinds.text: great tracks across the ice, and what is left of a seal
uses: do=tracks;none=The tracks lead off across the ice toward the open water.;x=-6;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=tracks;text=Paw prints a forearm across, sunk deep. A bear, and not long gone.

kinds.name: frozen_shipwreck
kinds.title: Frozen shipwreck
kinds.text: a ship frozen into the ice, its masts sticking out
uses: do=lore;x=-12;y=-4;r=3;verb=read;what=logbook;text=Last entry: the ice has us. We wait for spring. The ink has frozen in the pot.

kinds.name: ice_shelf
kinds.title: Ice shelf
kinds.text: the edge of an ice shelf, a cliff of ice calving with a roar
hazards: kind=rockfall;x=6;y=0;r=8;msg=A crack like thunder: the ice front calves above you!|Blocks of falling ice strike you
uses: do=lore;x=-10;y=0;r=3;verb=look up at;what=ice front;text=A wall of blue ice, its foot sunk in the sea. It moans. Now and then a piece the size of a house comes away.

kinds.name: expedition_hut
kinds.title: Expedition hut
kinds.text: an abandoned expedition's hut, supplies still in it, graves outside
uses: do=lore;x=-6;y=-8;r=3;verb=read;what=notes;text=We have food for a month and fuel for a week. If you find this, the cairn on the ridge holds our maps.

kinds.name: snow_houses
kinds.title: Snow houses
kinds.text: a seasonal hunting camp of snow houses, a hunter at the fire
folk: Townsman|Hunter|The seals come up at the holes when the light is low./A snow house is warm as any hall. Come in, sit./Bears follow the hunters. Keep your fire lit.|-4|-3
uses: do=heal;x=-5;y=3;r=3;verb=warm yourself at;what=fire;reuse=300;text=The hunter makes room by the fire. The cold goes out of your bones.

kinds.name: aurora_watch
kinds.title: Aurora hill
kinds.text: a rise where the old ones watched the northern lights
uses: do=buff;x=2;y=0;r=3;verb=watch from;what=hill;hours=night;early=Come back after dark: the lights come out over the north only by night.;name=The Lights' Blessing;dmg=0.1;armour=0.08;speed=0.05;secs=900;reuse=60;text=Green fire hangs over the north and moves like a slow wind. You feel it in your chest.

kinds.name: reed_bed
kinds.title: Reed bed
kinds.text: reeds taller than a man, hiding paths, nests and whatever waits in them
uses: do=forage;x=-14;y=0;r=3;verb=search;what=reed edge;things=Bird's Eggs|1|2|0.7;reuse=300;text=Nests in the reed edge, and paths through the reeds that something has trodden.

kinds.name: boardwalk
kinds.title: Boardwalk
kinds.text: a plank trail across the marsh on stakes, one stretch rotten and broken
hazards: kind=bog;x=8;y=0;r=2.5;msg=The planks give out and you are in the black mud to your knees
uses: do=lore;x=-6;y=-6;r=3;verb=look at;what=planks;text=Someone keeps this trail. Someone else has sawn through a stretch of it.

kinds.name: stilt_village
kinds.title: Stilt village
kinds.text: fishing huts raised on stilts above the water, their people on the platforms
folk: Townswoman|Fisher|The water rises every spring; our houses stay dry./Eels for bread, if you are hungry./Keep to the boards at night. The lights out there are not lanterns.|-2|-3
uses: do=trade;x=-3;y=1;r=3;verb=trade with;what=fisher;give=Bread|1;get=Fish|2;reuse=120

kinds.name: marsh_lights
kinds.title: Marsh lights
kinds.text: lights drifting over the marsh at night, leading off the path
uses: do=lore;x=-12;y=0;r=3;verb=watch;what=lights;text=Pale lights over the black water, always a little further off. The drowned follow them; so do the foolish.

kinds.name: heron_rookery
kinds.title: Heron rookery
kinds.text: herons and cranes wading the shallows; a flock bursts into the air
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=-8;r=3;verb=watch;what=herons;text=Grey herons stand like posts, then lift all at once with a sound like a sail.

kinds.name: fish_weir
kinds.title: Fish weir
kinds.text: a weir of stakes across a channel, eel traps in its gaps, a punt tied up
uses: do=fish;x=-4;y=-4;r=3;verb=empty;what=traps;things=Fish|1|3|0.9;reuse=300;text=Two eels and a pike in the traps, still alive.

kinds.name: salt_creek
kinds.title: Salt-marsh creek
kinds.text: a creek through the salt marsh that floods and drains with the tide
hazards: kind=tide;x=0;y=0;r=4;msg=The creek is filling: the tide is coming in under the grass|The tide takes your footing in the soft mud
uses: do=lore;x=-12;y=-8;r=3;verb=look at;what=creek;text=Twice a day the sea comes up this creek and fills the marsh. Twice a day it goes.

kinds.name: duck_blind
kinds.title: Duck blind
kinds.text: a hunter's hide of reeds at the water's edge
uses: do=lore;x=-5;y=0;r=3;verb=look into;what=hide;text=A plank seat, feathers, a broken arrow. From in here you could watch the whole pool.

kinds.name: sunken_causeway
kinds.title: Sunken causeway
kinds.text: an old stone road running under the water, its stones just showing
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=-8;r=3;verb=look at;what=road;text=Dressed stones, set straight as a ruler, a hand's depth under the water. Someone built a road here before the marsh.

kinds.name: drowned_church
kinds.title: Drowned church
kinds.text: a church drowned in the marsh, only its bell tower showing
uses: do=lore;x=-12;y=0;r=3;verb=listen to;what=tower;text=On still nights, they say, the bell still rings under the water.

kinds.name: cypress_swamp
kinds.title: Cypress swamp
kinds.text: drowned trees with knobby roots and hanging moss over dark water
uses: do=lore;x=-16;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=swamp;text=Trees standing in black water to their knees, moss hanging from them like rags. Nothing moves, then something does.

kinds.name: bog_body
kinds.title: Bog find
kinds.text: a peat cutting where the bog has given up an old idol, and something worse
uses: do=lore;x=-8;y=-6;r=3;verb=look at;what=find;text=A wooden god as tall as a man, and beside it a body with a rope still round its neck. The bog keeps everything.

kinds.name: floating_mat
kinds.title: Floating mat
kinds.text: a mat of floating vegetation that looks like solid ground
hazards: kind=thin_ice;x=0;y=0;r=4;msg=The green mat sinks under your weight: cold black water to your waist
uses: do=lore;x=-11;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=mat;text=Green and firm-looking, and it moves, very slightly, when the wind blows.

kinds.name: quicksand
kinds.title: Quicksand
kinds.text: a smooth patch of grey that swallows what steps on it
hazards: kind=bog;x=0;y=0;r=4;msg=Quicksand! It closes round your legs and pulls
uses: do=lore;x=-9;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=sand;text=Smooth, grey, without a footprint on it. Nothing walks here. That is the warning.

kinds.name: witch_hummock
kinds.title: Witch's hummock
kinds.text: a hummock of dry ground in the swamp, a hut on it, a woman who knows things
folk: Townswoman|Swamp witch|Bread for a cure, dearie./The lights are the drowned. Do not answer them./I knew you would come. I always know.|-4|-2
uses: do=offer;x=-4;y=-4;r=3;verb=leave an offering at;what=hut;give=Bread|1;name=The Witch's Charm;dmg=0.06;armour=0.1;secs=900;text=She takes the bread, mutters over a twist of hair and ties it round your wrist.

kinds.name: log_bridge
kinds.title: Log bridge
kinds.text: a fallen tree across a channel, the only dry way over
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=-8;r=3;verb=look at;what=log;text=Moss on top, rot underneath. It has held this long.

kinds.name: pitcher_plants
kinds.title: Pitcher plants
kinds.text: carnivorous pitcher plants grown huge in the bog
hazards: kind=sting;x=1;y=1;r=2.5;msg=The pitcher's sweet reek makes you dizzy, and its rim burns where you brushed it
uses: do=lore;x=-10;y=-6;r=3;verb=look into;what=pitcher;text=Liquid at the bottom, and in it the bones of a bird.

kinds.name: swamp_gas
kinds.title: Swamp gas
kinds.text: gas bubbling up through the black water; a lantern would light it
hazards: kind=gas;x=0;y=0;r=4;msg=The marsh gas catches in your throat; your head swims
uses: do=lore;x=-10;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=bubbles;text=Bubbles rise and burst, and the smell is rot and eggs. Hold a flame to it and it burns blue.

kinds.name: smugglers_camp
kinds.title: Smugglers' camp
kinds.text: a camp in the swamp no army can reach, its owners watching
uses: do=lore;x=-8;y=-6;r=3;verb=look at;what=crates;text=Crates with the duke's seal scraped off. Whoever brought them knows the swamp's paths.

kinds.name: driftwood_beach
kinds.title: Driftwood beach
kinds.text: a beach strewn with driftwood, shells and what the sea brings in
uses: do=forage;x=-4;y=4;r=3;verb=search;what=tide line;things=Straw Rope|1|1|0.5,Fish|1|1|0.5,Iron Ingot|1|1|0.3;reuse=300;text=Rope, a crab, a bent nail: the tide line's gifts.

kinds.name: buried_ruins
kinds.title: Buried ruins
kinds.text: dunes shifting off old walls, ruins coming out of the sand
uses: do=lore;x=-14;y=-4;r=3;verb=look at;what=walls;text=Last year this was a dune. The wind moved it, and here is a doorway nobody has walked through in a thousand years.

kinds.name: tidal_flat
kinds.title: Tidal flat
kinds.text: a flat that opens a path at low tide and drowns at high
uses: do=lore;x=-18;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=flat;text=A road across the mud at low water. The sea comes back faster than a man can run.

kinds.name: fishing_village
kinds.title: Fishing village
kinds.text: a fishing village: nets drying, boats pulled up, a smokehouse
folk: Townsman|Fisherman|The sea gives and the sea takes; mostly it takes./Smoked fish for bread, as much as you like./Wreckers on the point. They light fires to fool the ships.|-2|-2
uses: do=trade;x=-2;y=-4;r=3;verb=trade with;what=fisherman;give=Bread|1;get=Fish|3;reuse=120

kinds.name: lighthouse
kinds.title: Lighthouse
kinds.text: a lighthouse on the shore, its lantern lit by night
uses: do=climb;edge=1;r=4;verb=climb;what=lighthouse;tx=1.7;tz=11.8;reveal=4000;reuse=5;text=Up the spiral to the gallery. The sea, the coast, the ships' lights far out.

kinds.name: shipwreck_bar
kinds.title: Shipwreck
kinds.text: a ship wrecked on a sandbar, its cargo strewn about
uses: do=lore;x=-12;y=-6;r=3;verb=read;what=name;text=Her name is half gone from the bow. Her cargo is still coming ashore, a crate a tide.

kinds.name: lagoon
kinds.title: Lagoon
kinds.text: a lagoon of brackish water behind the dunes, birds of fresh and salt water both
uses: do=fish;x=1;y=-3;r=3;verb=fish;what=lagoon;things=Fish|1|2|0.8;reuse=240;text=Half salt, half sweet, and fish from both.

kinds.name: seabird_colony
kinds.title: Seabird colony
kinds.text: a seabird colony: noise, eggs and guano on every ledge
uses: do=forage;x=-10;y=0;r=3;verb=take eggs from;what=nests;things=Bird's Eggs|1|3|0.9;reuse=300;text=The birds scream at you. The eggs are warm.

kinds.name: wreckers_cove
kinds.title: Wreckers' cove
kinds.text: a cove where false lights lure ships onto the rocks, and its wreckers wait
uses: do=lore;x=-8;y=-6;r=3;verb=look at;what=fire;text=A fire on the point where no harbour is. Ships steer for it, and break on the rocks below.

kinds.name: sea_stacks
kinds.title: Sea stacks
kinds.text: pillars of rock standing off the cliffs
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=stacks;text=The sea took the land between them. It is still taking it.

kinds.name: sea_arch
kinds.title: Sea arch
kinds.text: an arch of rock the waves have cut through a headland
uses: do=lore;x=-14;y=0;r=3;verb=look at;what=arch;text=One day the arch will fall and leave a stack. The waves are in no hurry.

kinds.name: sea_cave
kinds.title: Sea cave
kinds.text: a sea cave in the rocks, reachable only at low tide
uses: do=loot;x=4;y=-3;r=3;verb=search;what=cave;tide=low;early=The sea fills the cave's mouth. Come back at low tide.;things=Fish|1|2|0.7,Copper Ingot|1|1|0.5;reuse=600;text=Low water: the cave's floor is dry, and something left a cache on a shelf above the tide line.

kinds.name: tide_pools
kinds.title: Tide pools
kinds.text: rock pools full of crabs, anemones and stranger things
uses: do=forage;x=0;y=0;r=3;verb=search;what=pools;things=Fish|1|2|0.8;reuse=300;text=Crabs, anemones, a starfish, and in one pool something with too many eyes that slides under a rock.

kinds.name: blowhole
kinds.title: Blowhole
kinds.text: a hole in the rocks that throws spray high when the waves come in
hazards: kind=geyser;x=0;y=0;r=3;every=20;msg=With a boom the blowhole throws spray high into the air!|The spray knocks you off your feet
uses: do=geyser;x=-9;y=0;r=3;verb=watch;what=blowhole;text=The rock booms under your feet as each wave comes in.

kinds.name: seal_rocks
kinds.title: Seal rocks
kinds.text: flat rocks where the seals haul out
uses: do=lore;x=0;y=-8;r=3;verb=watch;what=seals;text=Seals on the rocks, barking. They slide into the water as you come and watch you from it.

kinds.name: clifftop_ruin
kinds.title: Clifftop ruin
kinds.text: an abbey falling into the sea, a wall at a time
uses: do=lore;x=-4;y=8;r=3;verb=look at;what=ruin;text=Half the cloister is already in the sea. The rest is waiting.

kinds.name: rock_stairs
kinds.title: Rock-cut stairs
kinds.text: stairs cut up a rock face from a hidden cove
uses: do=climb;edge=1;r=4;verb=climb;what=stairs;tx=8;tz=7;reveal=2000;reuse=5;text=Steps worn by smugglers' boots, up the cliff to the top.

kinds.name: storm_surge
kinds.title: Storm surge
kinds.text: rocks where the waves sweep over and drag the careless in
uses: do=lore;x=-10;y=0;r=3;verb=watch;what=waves;text=Every seventh wave comes higher than the rest. Count, and do not be on the rocks when it comes.
